lines.1: 「Ugh... I can't believe a fever made me forget to touch the base.」
lines.2: 「Princess, your face is red. Are you okay?」
lines.3: Yoshimi anxiously pressed a hand to the Princess's forehead.
lines.4: 「Whoa, Ellie, your fever's even higher!! You have to rest!」
lines.5: 「If I rest now, I feel like I've lost. I'd tarnish the name of Erika Kiriya. I'll give the orders, so if you bat exactly as I say...」
lines.7: 「Princess, didn't I tell you that trusting your people is one of a ruler's essential qualities?」
lines.8: 「Then trust us and rest. We'll take the lead back.」
lines.10: I pressed the ice pillow I'd prepared against the Princess's forehead.
lines.14: 「I'm your boyfriend. I normally let you lead, but I'll speak up when I have to.」
lines.15: 「I'm not saying you're out of the game. At least lie down while we're batting.」
lines.16: 「There, you heard him. You may use my lap as a pillow, so lie down.」
lines.18: 「How many minutes do you need before you can pitch again?」
lines.19: 「...If I cool my head like this, five minutes should be enough.」
lines.21: 「All right! You heard her. Let's score some runs ourselves!」
lines.23: 「We all give it everything we've got.」
lines.24: 「Oh, so the strategy is pure guts? You really are Otome's little brother.」
lines.25: 「It's not impossible. We've always been one step from scoring. We just need one more push.」
lines.26: 「Big talk from the guy who's been hitless all game.」
lines.27: 「That's why I'm making up for it.」
lines.28: 「Get some runners on before I come up. I'll drive them in.」
lines.29: 「A-aren't you acting a little out of character?」
lines.30: 「That 'little more' sounds pretty far away to me.」
lines.31: 「I just have to hit it, right? Then I will.」
lines.32: 「Oh, now he's fired up. Once he gets like this, he gets tunnel vision.」
lines.33: 「That's pretty cool... though it'll be painfully lame if you miss.」
lines.34: 「Looks like he's finally caught fire. Been a while since Leo got like this.」
lines.35: 「Hmph. Took you long enough to heat up in a spot like this.」
lines.36: 「Can't be helped. My friend is begging me, so I guess I'll get on base.」
lines.38: 「You! Don't say something that cruel with a serious face at a time like this!」
lines.39: 「But your at-bats so far have been a total disaster, haven't they?」
lines.40: 「Hmph. I'll show you how I fight.」
lines.41: Unlike before, Fukahire chose the longest bat and headed to the plate.
lines.42: Then, just as the Princess had, he pointed the bat high into the sky.
lines.43: 「I'll send it all the way to wherever my future girlfriend is!」
lines.45: And this came right after the Princess had made good on hers.
lines.48: 「It's a bluff, Nishizaki. Pitch as usual.」
lines.51: Whoosh! He took a mighty swing.
lines.54: But it was a powerful uppercut swing. If it connected, the ball really might fly.
lines.57: Faced with Fukahire's intensity, the fielders edged backward.
lines.60: Without warning, Fukahire tapped down a bunt.
lines.62: Caught off guard, Konoe at third scrambled forward.
lines.63: But after Fukahire's claim that he'd send it to the girlfriend he hadn't met yet, she looked a little disgusted to go near him.
lines.64: That revulsion cost her just enough time.
lines.65: She threw to first, but the result was--safe.
lines.66: 「Heh. Thanks to my big sister bullying me since I was little, I've always been fast on my feet.」
lines.67: Impala and zebras are finished if they get caught, so naturally they're very fast.
lines.68: Fukahire had built decent leg strength for much the same reason.
lines.69: 「Damn it, my disgust slowed me down. Sorry, everyone!」
lines.71: 「Fukahire! After all that bragging, you lay down a safety bunt?!」
lines.72: Boos came raining down from the stands too.
lines.73: 「Samesuga took all that abuse just to get on base for Tsushima.」
lines.74: 「Well, yeah... He hadn't reached base once yet either, so I bet pride had something to do with it.」
lines.75: 「Besides, being booed cannot lower his reputation any further.」
lines.76: 「I have to do my best too...」
lines.78: 「Yoppi, lend me your ear for a moment.」
lines.80: 「Wh-what? What?! E-even if you tell me that, I...」
lines.81: Yoshimi headed to the plate with flushed cheeks.
lines.83: 「I told her the simple fact that if she gets a hit, she will receive a kiss from you, Tsushima.」
lines.84: Inori whispered that outrageous fabrication so only I could hear.
lines.86: 「I also promised a deep one for a double, and takeout for a triple.」
lines.90: The ball split the gap between first and second.
lines.93: 「Wait, whoa?! You're going for a double?」
lines.95: Fukahire had meant to stop at second, but when he saw Yoshimi charging toward him, he hurried on to third.
lines.98: The throw came in from right field.
lines.101: Murata caught the incoming ball and tagged the sliding Yoshimi!
lines.107: Yoshimi brushed the dirt from her gym clothes, stealing repeated glances at me with flushed cheeks.
lines.108: 「The gigolo who steals girls' hearts at home plate is up to bat.」
lines.111: I looked at the Princess resting her head in Inori's lap.
lines.113: True, knowing we still had the bottom of the ninth gave us some room to breathe mentally...
lines.114: But I had to go up there determined to settle it now.
lines.116: I'd spent my previous at-bats resting my hands and studying the pitcher. In that time, I'd noticed something.
lines.117: Whenever Nishizaki threw her dropping curve, she made a little motion as if re-gripping the ball once inside her glove.
lines.118: I wasn't certain, so I hadn't told the others, but betting on that was my only chance to hit her.
lines.119: My hands were already torn to pieces too.
lines.120: I could manage one real swing at most.
lines.123: Second pitch: low and away, fastball, strike.
lines.124: 「You're not swinging in this at-bat either, senpai.」
lines.125: 「Perhaps he has chosen one pitch to target.」
lines.126: Third pitch: a deceptive slow ball, strike.
lines.127: 「Hey, he's down to his last strike.」
lines.128: 「No. That look says he's waiting for something.」
lines.129: Fourth pitch: just below the zone, ball.
lines.132: On the fifth pitch, Nishizaki squeezed the ball and re-gripped it.
lines.133: This was it! The dropping curve!
lines.134: If I struck the underside of the incoming ball...
lines.135: It was slow, so matching its timing was easy.
lines.138: The impact shot through my palms.
lines.139: But I had no time to care about the pain.
lines.140: The ball flew straight into the left-center gap.
lines.142: 「Yes! He really hit it! That's the hot-blooded Leo we know!」
lines.143: 「One can see the desperation of a man who had been hitless until now.」
lines.145: The center fielder chased down the ball that had split left-center.
lines.146: 「I'll touch home with a backflip! Here I go!」
lines.147: 「Stop fooling around and cross home plate!」
lines.150: The relay throw came back in.
lines.151: But it was already too late.
lines.155: While they were distracted, I headed for third...!
lines.157: Nishizaki noticed from the mound, cut off the relay, and fired quickly to third.
lines.160: A booming cry of "Out!" rang across the field.
lines.166: 「Good grief. He really does stop seeing everything around him...」
lines.167: 「Can't criticize the Princess for that, can you?」
lines.169: The eighth batter battled to a full count, buying precious time before finally making an out.
lines.173: 「I got a full five minutes of rest, and you even took the lead.」
lines.174: 「If I don't close it out properly now, I am not Erika Kiriya.」
lines.175: 「More importantly, can those hands of yours keep going?」
lines.177: 「You kept shaking them after catching my pitches. It was rather obvious.」
lines.178: 「Since you've come this far, see it through to the end.」
lines.181: 「Still, I never expected you to worry about my hands.」
lines.184: 「Kidding. Ahaha, look how red you got!」
lines.185: Damn it. A sick girl was teasing me...
lines.186: The top of the ninth began with their third batter.
lines.189: 「The one who settles this in the end--」
lines.190: 「What?! Her pitches have even more force now! What kind of rise is that?!」
lines.191: 「Thank you for striking out while explaining everything for us.」
lines.194: The fifth batter was Nishizaki, the pitcher Erika had homered off earlier.
lines.195: 「Time to repay that debt and finish this!」
lines.197: Nishizaki's bat cut through empty air.
lines.200: The members of Class 2-A hung their heads.
lines.201: The members of Class 2-C, meanwhile, went wild with joy.
lines.202: The contrast could not have been clearer.
lines.207: 「Then use that frustration as a springboard and grow stronger.」
lines.208: 「And to the victors, glory! I present you with this prize!」
lines.209: 「Ugh, right. I forgot there was a prize too.」
lines.211: 「I would normally suggest a fair game of rock-paper-scissors, but...」
